text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Lunch break. I spotted Seiun Sky and was about
to call out to her, but...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Sei-chan, that thing the other day was amazing~!
I felt like I got so much out of it!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, we have other featured items too~.
We make a killing with them.
If you want those too, I can set them aside for you?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, please do! Ah, that's right!
Can I tell my other friends about it too?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good to me. Everyone wins, after all.
Feel free to keep referring them my way~. Later!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...What an indescribably suspicious conversation.
Just as I hesitated over whether to call out to them...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Sky-san!
Stop with the shady business this instant!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, you scared me!
Huh, what are you talking about?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Don't play dumb! Talking about making a fortune, brokering deals! You were clearly talking about shady underworld business!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Ah. I see, I see.
So that's how it is.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, this is bad. I've been found out, huh...
As expected of King... or should I say, Great Detective King.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"You're sorely mistaken if you think you can escape my sight!
Now, turn over a new—"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, before that. What kind of dirt
do they have on you, Sei-chan?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You're a great detective, after all. Naturally,
you've already secured decisive evidence, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ah...... Of course I did!!
Don't underestimate the King's investigative skills!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oh, scary, scary. Looks like Sei-chan better get her affairs in order.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Kh... In that case,
I have to catch their tail no matter what...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, you over there!
Sky-san's Trainer, who's been watching from the side this whole time!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Cooperate with the investigation! Aren't you
worried about Sky-san too!?"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"So as a special privilege, I'll grant you the right
to suggest how we should gather evidence! Let's hear it!"
choice_data_list: Catch them in the act and storm in!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I see, a stakeout and tailing!
Now that that's settled, let's go after them right away!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Phew. All right, one more lap.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Seiun Sky is doing voluntary training...?! How suspicious! There has to be something going on!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oho, if it isn't Great Detective King...
Is your Trainer your assistant, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Sky-san... It's bizarre seeing you
train eagerly on your own.
There's definitely something up, isn't there?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Well, it might sound suspicious, sure~
But what do you mean by 'something', for example?"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
T-That's, uhm... She could be testing out
the performance of illegally forged horseshoes!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...No! I bet she's pretending to do voluntary training,
going around making contacts for underground deals,
or secretly smuggling black market goods!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oho, what a bold and imaginative deduction.
As expected of you, King. I'm truly impressed.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho, isn't that right!
Just give it up already!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Alright, alright. Guess it's about time I give in
and show it to you."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: —Prized vegetables grown by Sei-chan's family.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Haaah!? You were just sharing
vegetables with everyoneeee!?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. My family sent a bunch of stuff over~
so Sei-chan's feeling totally energized now.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: W-Why didn't you tell me?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, let's just say I wanted to see what
the 'baffled detective' King is capable of.
...Farewell!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Wh-Wh... What the heck?!
Sky-saaaan!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky leading the charge, pursued by King Halo.
I watched the two of them sprint away with mixed emotions...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I see! Instead of gathering trivial evidence, we'll catch them red-handed at the scene!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, King Halo's friends joined in,
and everyone decided to stake out together.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, I'm exhausted...
Man, carrying "this" around isn't easy either.

text_block_list.name: Bob-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Uhh, King. This is Point A.
Seiun Sky is currently taking a break~.
She has an extremely suspicious-looking bag right next to her~.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Now's our chance!
Everyone, let's go!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Give it up, Sky-san! I've finally caught you red-handed with decisive proof!

text_block_list.name: Cat-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text: You're under arrest! Surrender now!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ohoho, if it isn't the King Detective Agency!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...And then.
When I examined the contents of the crucial package—"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Wh... What is this?
There are only vegetables in here...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: "Because I was just handing out vegetables sent from my family home to everyone. We're a farming family, after all."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
N-No way...
So, it was all just a misunderstanding on my part...?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe.
Quite the colossal swing and miss there, 'Detective' King.

text_block_list.name: Cat-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Well, anyways.
Those vegetables look delicious, Sky-san.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, if you want some, I can bring it later.
I still have plenty left over.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Mmm, but that adds yet another delivery destination. Even as muscle training, this might be a bit much~

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I kinda want someone to help me out here, nya~
...Like a certain someone who suspected me of weird things, for instance.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
A-Alright, fine!
I'll help you out to make up for it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...A few days later, word came that Seiun Sky,
with King Halo's help, had successfully
finished handing out all the vegetables."
